description: APPROVAL CARD ONLY — NEVER auto-executed: propose a trade setup for the user to approve in-app (Diary → setups → Send to ticket). Never executes, never moves funds. Needs the trade:propose scope (PAT).

invalidation.description: Optional invalidation note captured alongside the proposal

jev_verdict.description: Optional caller-supplied JEV verdict captured alongside the proposal

kronos_captured_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp of the Kronos vote

kronos_expected_move_pct.description: Optional Kronos expected move in percent

side.description: Side to propose: buy|sell (long|short accepted as aliases, normalized to buy|sell)

size_usd.description: Suggested size in USD, must be > 0

name: propose_trade
title: Propose trade setup
